title: Define boot and steady-state Agent Runtime control loops
purpose: Define how AgentOS boots into Agent Runtime control and keeps steady-state operation under bounded loops.
scope: Map boot handoff, runtime validation, policy/tool/model config load and recovery scan.
Define steady-state observation, planning, scheduling, execution and projection loops.
Define loop inputs, outputs, persistence and backpressure.
Document which loops run in local-only mode.
implementation_steps: Describe boot loop and steady-state loop state machines.
Identify durable state needed before each side effect.
List metrics and operator projection fields.
Record evidence with loop ownership and gate commands.
acceptance_criteria: Boot loop does not require external dependencies.
Steady-state loop cannot execute outside SecurityExecutionEngine.
Projection can show loop health and degraded state.
failure_modes: Runtime loop depends on remote model.
Side effects occur before durable state.
